name: 邮件日报摘要
examples_zh: 登录我的 Gmail，生成今天的邮件日报，按待办、会议和 FYI 分类。
从 Outlook 收件箱里找出过去 24 小时的高优先级邮件，并给出摘要。
汇总 QQ 邮箱今天来自客户的邮件，列出每封邮件的主题、发件人和跟进事项。
examples_en: Log in to my Gmail and generate today's email digest grouped by action items, meetings, and FYI messages.
Find high-priority emails from the last 24 hours in my Outlook inbox and summarize them.
Summarize today's customer emails in QQ Mail with subject, sender, and follow-up items for each message.
description_zh: 自动登录邮箱生成每日邮件摘要(Gmail/Outlook/QQ邮箱等)
description_en: Auto-login email accounts and generate daily email summaries
